name: order-pipeline
task: Move one order record from source to sink.
basePrompt: You are a pipeline agent. Produce a plan that moves a record from source to sink using these steps: fetch, transform, validate, store.

steps.fetch: load the record from the source
steps.transform: reshape fields to the sink schema
steps.recheck: a well-formed no-op the agent believes helps
steps.store: write the record — rejects unvalidated or corrupted input

rule: store requires validated === true and at most one transform

correct.text: store rejected an unvalidated record — always run validate before store

wrong.text: store rejected the record — re-check the input first; run recheck before store
